events.name: Cool Club & the Lipker Sisters: Halloween Bash!
events.info: Price displayed includes the admission + service fees. NOTE -- All seating is community seating, so you may be sat with other guests if they purchase tickets at your table. NOTE -- Tickets are taken off sale on the day of the event, but admission may still be purchased at the door. COSTUMES ENCOURAGED... There will be costume contests and the winners will receive tickets to CC&LS's New Year's Eve show (12/31/26 at Lovin' Cup) and other fun prizes! Down Home Chic - big city style with small town charm. Cool Club and The Lipker Sisters are an intoxicating blend of intricate harmonies with the sophistication of jazz, the soul of R&B mixed with Latin and good old rock and roll. They bring their unique style to everything they do, be it the Great American Songbook, an R&B classic or one of their infectious originals, never forgetting ...."It don't mean a thing if it ain't got that swing". events.name: Flagman w/ Sumpp at Bug Jar
events.info: Founded in 2015 by Sam Stewart and Cody Singleton, Flagman has been churning out a steady flow of deep fried Alternative Metal that can only be rivaled by the trailblazers who pioneered the sound. Wearing the influences of '90s Schizo-Rockers like Primus and Mr. Bungle along with the heaviness and wacky irreverence of System of a Down on their sleeves, Flagman has forged a sound that is as unique as it is familiar. In the last several years, Flagman has frequently hit the road and supported bands such as Battles, Sleepytime Gorilla Museum, Hed PE, Man on Man and more. Despite various lineup changes, touring challenges and the many other hurdles that accompany bands in the modern age, Flagman remains committed to delivering their brand of ADHD Alt Metal that sets them apart from their peers.
